name: Waitwise
customer: US residents who need an in-person USPS passport appointment and keep seeing no RCAS availability; secondary: campers missing Recreation.gov release windows
problem: Scarce passport appointment slots create refresh loops and trip risk; unofficial scrapers are brittle/ToS-risky; free official-path prep is thin compared with alert products.
business_model: Free passport-primary prep pack + waitlist now; camping secondary; later optional policy-compliant alerts only inside OWNER Class 2 commerce envelope.

brand.name: Waitwise
brand.positioning: Scarce US passport appointment prep — official paths, no scrape. Alerts not offered while commerce is off.
brand.promise: Prep the official path. Know what to try when RCAS is empty.
brand.name_collision_note: Other WaitWise products mean queue/live wait times; disclose on site.
